items.name: docx-thesis
items.title: Docx Thesis
items.description: Write a thesis in Word without losing the discipline of a source-controlled workflow: author chapters in Markdown or LaTeX, convert with pandoc and a reference .docx that carries the department's styles, manage citations through Zotero with Better BibTeX so the .bib stays the source of truth, and handle the Word-specific submission checks (styles, table of contents, captions, tracked changes). Use when the department requires .docx, the supervisor comments in Word, or a LaTeX draft must become a Word document.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
